question: Electromagnetic induction was discovered by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Michael Faraday**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Michael Faraday** is credited with the **discovery of electromagnetic induction.**
 
• His experiments in **1831 **demonstrated that a c**hanging magnetic field could induce an electric current in a circuit.**
 
• This discovery laid the groundwork for the development of modern electromagnetic technology, including **electric generators and transformers.**
 
• Faraday's work in electromagnetism and electrochemistry earned him a place as one of the most influential scientists in history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alessandro Volta** was known for his invention of the electric battery and the discovery of methane.
 
• **Isaac Newton** made significant contributions to physics and mathematics, including the laws of motion and universal gravitation.
 
• **Albert Einstein** is famous for his theory of relativity and his contributions to the understanding of quantum mechanics.
 
• Electromagnetic induction is a fundamental principle utilized in various applications, including power generation and wireless charging.
 
• Faraday's law of induction states that the induced electromotive force in any closed circuit is equal to the negative of the time rate of change of the magnetic flux through the circuit.
